situation: My manager asks for volunteers for a demanding new project with a tight deadline.
behavior: I raise my hand immediately and agree to take it on, without reviewing my current workload first.

situation: After finishing a drink at home, I leave the empty glass on the counter instead of placing it in the dishwasher
behavior: I set the glass down wherever I am and move on without considering where it belongs

situation: Walking down a busy sidewalk and seeing a 'Wet Paint' sign on a bench
behavior: I sit down on the bench anyway, feeling the fresh paint on my pants.

situation: I sit at my desk with a deadline looming and an inbox full of urgent emails.
behavior: I open a web browser and spend the next hour reading news articles instead of opening the project file.

situation: At a grocery store, I see a flashy dessert display near the checkout.
behavior: I grab a triple-chocolate cake without checking my budget or if I have room in the fridge.

situation: When I take off my shoes after getting home, I kick them off wherever I'm standing instead of putting them in the closet.
behavior: I leave them on the floor for days, stepping over them each time I walk by.

situation: I promise my boss I will finish the quarterly report by Friday afternoon
behavior: I close my laptop Thursday night and spend Friday running personal errands instead of submitting it

situation: I'm supposed to be cleaning the kitchen but I find myself scrolling through my phone instead
behavior: I spend 45 minutes watching cooking videos and only start washing dishes when it's already past midnight

situation: At a furniture store with my roommate, I spot a dining table on sale and decide to buy it without measuring my apartment.
behavior: I hand over my credit card immediately, ignoring my roommate's suggestion that we should check the dimensions first.

situation: At a Japanese restaurant, the menu is entirely in Japanese with no pictures
behavior: Signals the waiter and points at a random dish rather than attempting to decode the menu

situation: When I finish a snack at my desk, I set the wrapper on the stack of papers beside my keyboard.
behavior: I leave it there and return to work, even though the trash can is within arm's reach.

situation: At my retail job, a manager assigns me a restocking task during a busy shift.
behavior: I convince a new employee that taking over my assignment will help them learn the inventory system, then clock out early.
affect: Relief that I escaped the tedious work.

situation: Saturday morning, they promised to organize the garage before a family gathering
behavior: They remain on the couch scrolling through their phone while the garage stays cluttered, and only start when their spouse hands them a trash bag

situation: At a theme park, I spot the highest roller coaster with the steepest drop
behavior: I sprint to the front of the line and ride it three times consecutively without checking safety ratings

situation: In a department brainstorming meeting, the project manager asks everyone to suggest improvements to the new workflow.
behavior: They stay quiet, shrug, and say, 'I don't have any ideas, you all know better.'

situation: A coworker shows me their overflowing email inbox during a meeting
behavior: I nod along and say nothing about the chaos, then leave my own inbox unsorted

situation: During a weekly deadline for a project update, my manager asks for a brief summary.
behavior: I write a one-paragraph summary with only the required data, then close the document without adding extra insights.

situation: Monday morning, three days of unread bills and tax documents sit in a pile on the home office desk, with the filing deadline two weeks away.
behavior: I sit at the desk, glance at the pile, then spend the next two hours organizing the bookshelf and cleaning kitchen drawers instead of opening a single envelope.
affect: Guilty and vaguely anxious, but relieved to avoid the task

situation: I'm walking through Target and spot a discounted air fryer by the checkout lane.
behavior: I grab it and put it in my cart without checking my bank balance or whether I already own a similar appliance at home.
affect: Excited and satisfied in the moment

situation: At a performance review, my supervisor asks why I missed last week's deadline
behavior: I blame system issues and technical errors instead of admitting I forgot to prioritize the task

situation: I arrive 15 minutes late to a Monday morning project planning meeting with no preparation.
behavior: I sit in the back, scroll through my phone, and give vague one-word answers when asked for input on deadlines.

situation: A friend texts me at 7pm asking if I want to grab dinner at a new restaurant opening tonight
behavior: I immediately say yes, get dressed in whatever is clean, and head out without checking if I have enough cash
